title: ERC-4337: FailedOp
summary: The EntryPoint reverted validation with FailedOp(uint256 opIndex, string reason); the reason is expected to begin with an AAxx code that identifies whether the sender, factory, paymaster, or EntryPoint path failed.
likelyCauses: The bundler simulation rejected a UserOperation before inclusion.
The AAxx reason string points to the failing phase: account creation, account validation, paymaster validation, gas accounting, or EntryPoint bookkeeping.
The underlying cause may still require decoding an account, factory, or paymaster revert.
nextSteps: Extract the AAxx code from the FailedOp reason and use the AA code entry for the targeted fix.
Use the opIndex to identify the failing UserOperation in a bundle.
If the failing phase is factory or paymaster validation, trace the last called entity because ERC-4337 attributes simulation failures by the last entity called before the revert.

title: ERC-4337: FailedOpWithRevert
summary: EntryPoint v0.7+ can wrap the AAxx reason together with inner revert bytes from the account, factory, or paymaster, so the outer AA code tells the failing phase and the inner bytes often reveal the contract-specific reason.
likelyCauses: The account, factory, or paymaster reverted during EntryPoint validation.
The AAxx reason identifies the failing phase, while the inner bytes carry a standard Error(string), Panic, or custom error.
The same outer AA code can have different fixes depending on the decoded inner revert.
nextSteps: Decode FailedOpWithRevert to get opIndex, AAxx reason, and inner revert bytes.
Run the inner bytes through the revert decoder with the account, factory, or paymaster ABI.
Apply the fix from the decoded inner error before changing gas fields or retrying.

title: AA21: didn't pay prefund
summary: The sender could not prefund the UserOperation through its EntryPoint deposit or native balance, and no valid paymaster funding path covered the operation.
likelyCauses: The smart account lacks enough native token or EntryPoint deposit to cover the required prefund.
The client expected sponsorship but did not attach valid paymaster fields for the EntryPoint version.
Gas or fee fields raised the required prefund above the account's available balance.
nextSteps: If no paymaster is used, fund the smart account or deposit for it through EntryPoint.depositTo.
If sponsorship is expected, regenerate and attach paymaster data for the same chain, account, and EntryPoint version.
Re-estimate gas and fee fields after final calldata and signatures are set so the prefund calculation is current.

title: AA23: reverted (or OOG)
summary: The smart account's validateUserOp path reverted or exhausted validation gas, so EntryPoint could not accept the sender's UserOperation.
likelyCauses: The account validation logic rejected the UserOperation because of signature, session key, nonce policy, module policy, or account state.
verificationGasLimit is too low for the account's validateUserOp execution.
The account needs prefund or paymaster fields that were not present or were malformed.
nextSteps: If FailedOpWithRevert is present, decode the inner revert before changing gas settings.
Re-run UserOperation gas estimation with the final signature, paymaster data, EntryPoint address, and chain id.
Verify the account's signature scheme, session/module policy, and prefund path against the exact UserOperation hash.

title: AA24: signature error
summary: The account validation path returned a signature failure: the signature does not validate for this UserOperation hash, EntryPoint address, chain id, signer, or account signature scheme.
likelyCauses: The UserOperation was signed with the wrong private key, owner, session key, or passkey credential.
The userOpHash was computed with the wrong EntryPoint address, chain id, nonce, gas fields, or calldata.
The account expects a different signature envelope, such as EIP-1271, modular validator bytes, or aggregated signature data.
nextSteps: Recompute userOpHash from the exact UserOperation sent to the bundler, using the target chain id and EntryPoint address.
Confirm the signer or validator configured in the smart account matches the signature source.
Regenerate the signature after paymaster data, gas fields, nonce, and calldata are finalized.

references.label: Alchemy Wallet API invalid signature troubleshooting

title: AA25: invalid account nonce
summary: The UserOperation nonce is not the nonce the EntryPoint/account expects for this sender and nonce key; it may be reused, too far ahead, or encoded with the wrong key/sequence format.
likelyCauses: The client reused a nonce that was already included or is already pending.
Parallel UserOperations are using the same nonce key and sequence.
The nonce is formatted incorrectly or jumps too far beyond the account's current sequence.
nextSteps: Read the current nonce from EntryPoint.getNonce(sender, key) immediately before building the UserOperation.
Use separate nonce keys only when the account supports that parallelization model.
Cancel or wait for pending UserOperations that occupy the same nonce before resubmitting.

title: AA31: paymaster deposit too low
summary: The selected paymaster does not have enough EntryPoint deposit to prefund the UserOperation it is supposed to sponsor.
likelyCauses: The paymaster deposit at the EntryPoint is below the required prefund.
The operation's gas and fee fields increased the sponsorship cost above the paymaster's available deposit.
A third-party sponsorship service is misconfigured, inactive, or out of funds for this chain.
nextSteps: If you operate the paymaster, top up its EntryPoint deposit with depositTo(paymaster).
If you use a hosted sponsor, request fresh paymaster data and check the sponsorship policy status.
Re-estimate the UserOperation gas so the paymaster sees the current prefund requirement.

title: AA33: paymaster reverted (or OOG)
summary: The paymaster's validatePaymasterUserOp path reverted or exhausted its validation gas, so EntryPoint rejected the sponsored UserOperation.
likelyCauses: The paymaster policy rejected the account, target call, token payment, chain, app, or spending limit.
The paymaster signature or authorization data is malformed for the EntryPoint version.
The validation gas budget is too low for the paymaster's policy checks.
nextSteps: Decode inner revert bytes if FailedOpWithRevert is present.
Regenerate paymaster data immediately before submission and confirm the sponsorship policy is active.
Increase the relevant paymaster verification gas only if tracing shows validation gas exhaustion rather than policy rejection.
